title: The Office User role grays out Technician with the role tooltip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open the New Staff Member window.
  2. If Time Clock is off, switch it on.
  3. In Role, pick "Office User".
  4. Hover the Technician toggle.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Staff Member window opens.

Step 2:

  • Time Clock is on.

Step 3:

  • Role shows Office User.
  • Technician is off and grayed out.
  • Clicking the Technician toggle does not switch it on.

Step 4:

  • A tooltip shows "This role can't be a technician."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S1-N1: “When the role picked in the window is the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, the Technician toggle is off and grayed out, and hovering it shows "This role can't be a technician." Picking one of those roles turns Technician off. In Edit Staff Member, saving a staff member who was saved with Technician on and now has one of those roles shows the Turn Off Technician warning first (Story 2). Any other role, including a custom role made from either built-in role, never grays it out.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the grayed-out Technician toggle on the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role (S1-N1) | "This role can't be a technician." | Tooltip while hovering”
  • S3-N2: “A person on the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role is never offered, as today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "3 When Technician can't be turned on", picture "Built-in Office User role" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p3-02-after-built-in-office-user-role.png

The design's own words:

  • “On the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, Technician is off and grayed out. Tooltip, verbatim: "This role can't be a technician." Picking one of those roles turns Technician off.”
  • “Any other role, including a custom role copied from either one, never grays it out.”

The design draws the Office User role only; Time Clock User and the custom roles are not drawn (register TT-N03).
